100: /**
101:  * Validates a date triple (day, month, year) for logical consistency and age constraint.
102:  * - Checks numeric format and valid ranges.
103:  * - Verifies that the date exists.
104:  * - Enforces minimum age of 13 years.
105:  *
106:  * @return Triple of day, month, and year error messages (null for valid).
107:  */
108: fun validateDateTriple(
109:     day: String,
110:     month: String,
111:     year: String
112: ): Triple<String?, String?, String?> {
113:   val dayErr =
114:       when {
115:         day.isBlank() -> "Day cannot be empty"
116:         day.toIntOrNull() == null || day.toInt() !in 1..31 -> "Invalid day"
117:         else -> null
118:       }
119:   val monthErr =
120:       when {
121:         month.isBlank() -> "Month cannot be empty"
122:         month.toIntOrNull() == null || month.toInt() !in 1..12 -> "Invalid month"
123:         else -> null
124:       }
125:   val yearErr =
126:       when {
127:         year.isBlank() -> "Year cannot be empty"
128:         year.toIntOrNull() == null || year.toInt() !in 1900..LocalDate.now().year -> "Invalid year"
129:         else -> null
130:       }
131:   if (dayErr != null || monthErr != null || yearErr != null) {
132:     return Triple(dayErr, monthErr, yearErr)
133:   }
134:   try {
135:     val dob = LocalDate.of(year.toInt(), month.toInt(), day.toInt())
136:     if (Period.between(dob, LocalDate.now()).years < 13) {
137:       return Triple(null, null, "Must be at least 13 years old")
138:     }
139:   } catch (_: DateTimeException) {
140:     return Triple("Invalid day", "Invalid month", "Invalid year")
141:   }
142:   return Triple(null, null, null)
143: }
